effective_date_source_text: Effective for bills rendered on and after October 18, 2023

charges.label: Customer Requested Test - Administrative Fee
charges.source_text: Customer shall pay an Administrative Fee of $50 per occurrence plus the replacement cost of all fuel consumed during the test.
charges.note: per-occurrence fee (unit outside the base enum) plus fuel replacement cost

notes: NEGATIVE CONTROL THAT IS NOT FULLY ZERO: DEP NC First Revised Leaf No. 660, Rider PPS. The Monthly Services Payment is formula/contract-based (no fixed value), but p2 prints ONE fixed charge: an Administrative Fee of $50 per occurrence for a customer-requested generator test. Recorded as the single expected charge; expected_zero=false. Non-charge numerics: 50 kW min / 250 MW max generator capacity, 10-year pricing floor, 60 days notice, $5 million credit threshold.
